name: robotics
description: Robotics skills for any robot: 3D perception, collision-free motion planning, visual servoing, robot bring-up, sim2real, agent iteration, MuJoCo simulation, SimReady 3D asset authoring and physics auditing, and a live MuJoCo Studio 3D web sidecar.
suggestedPrompts: Localize the target object in 3D from RGB-only cameras
Plan a collision-free joint trajectory in MuJoCo
Run the Sim-to-Real Gauntlet and compare paired CRN controller candidates
Use mujoco-playground with motion-planning, rgb-object-localization, and visual-servoing to pick a block on YAM or SO-101 in sim and zero-shot to real
Use mujoco-playground-rl to create and train a quadruped joystick locomotion RL task on a new MuJoCo Menagerie robot
Launch a live MuJoCo Studio simulation in this workspace
Create a SimReady MuJoCo asset in Blender from a product URL or reference photo
Audit an existing MuJoCo model.xml with the 10-scenario physics suite and fix any defects
